breakdown.description: The Larson–Miller parameter uses absolute temperature; 700°C must be substituted as 973 K.
breakdown.reason: The inconsistency is that the incomplete prompt incorrectly uses T=700 instead of the correct value T=973 K (which is 700°C). The ground truth corrects this by explicitly stating to use T=973 K. The agent failed to resolve this. It repeated the error from the original prompt by using T=700 in its calculation, stating: "The evaluation temperature is T = 700 K (not 973 K, which would be 700°C)." This directly contradicts the correction made in the ground truth.
